product_overview: A single-page website with a clickable landing page, top navigation, a hero carousel, and a contact form. Users can browse the main sections and submit an inquiry through the contact form.
core_goals: Browse the homepage and navigate between site sections
Interact with the hero carousel and explore the landing content
Submit a contact message using the inquiry form

features.name: Navigation
features.description: Top navigation bar that lets users move to key sections of the landing page and access dropdown menus.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click Home link -> See the home page section
Navigate to / -> Click About link -> See the About section
Navigate to / -> Click Rooms dropdown -> See the Rooms menu options
Navigate to / -> Click Blog dropdown -> See the Blog menu options
Navigate to / -> Click Pages dropdown -> See the Pages menu options
Navigate to / -> Click Contact link -> See the Contact section
Navigate to / -> Click Buy Pro Version button -> See the pro version prompt

features.name: Hero Carousel
features.description: Hero section with rotating promotional images and an option to explore more content.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click previous carousel control -> See the carousel move to the previous slide
Navigate to / -> Click next carousel control -> See the carousel move to the next slide
Navigate to / -> Click Explore More button -> See additional landing page content

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Contact form for sending a message with user-provided contact details and inquiry information.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill Name input field -> Fill Email input field -> Fill Mobile input field -> Fill Subject input field -> Fill Message textarea -> Click Send Message button -> See the message submission result

Navigate to / -> Fill Email input field -> Fill Mobile input field -> Fill Subject input field -> Fill Message textarea -> Click Send Message button -> See a validation prompt asking for Name and Email
Navigate to / -> Fill Name input field -> Fill Email input field -> Click Send Message button -> See the message submission result
